meaning.en: Hari Om (an invocatory opening)
this syllable, Om
all of this (the whole universe)
here is the unfolding explanation of it
what has been, what is, what is to come
meaning.hi: जो हो चुका, जो है, जो होने वाला है

meaning.en: all of it is nothing but the syllable Om
and whatever else is beyond the three times (past, present, future)
meaning.hi: और जो कुछ तीनों कालों से परे है

meaning.en: that too is Om alone

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: truly, all of this is brahman
this self is brahman
that very self
has four feet, four quarters
meaning.hi: चार पैरों वाला, चार हिस्सों वाला

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whose place is the waking state
whose awareness faces outward
meaning.hi: जिसका ज्ञान बाहर की ओर है

meaning.en: having seven limbs, seven parts
having nineteen mouths, nineteen doorways
who enjoys/eats the coarse, physical world
Vaishvanara, the one common to all people
the first quarter, the first foot

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whose place is the dreaming state
whose awareness faces inward
meaning.hi: जिसका ज्ञान भीतर की ओर है

meaning.en: having the same seven limbs and nineteen mouths
meaning.hi: वही सात अंग और उन्नीस मुख

meaning.en: who enjoys/eats the subtle, refined world
Taijasa, the one made of light
the second quarter

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: where, when asleep
desires no desire at all
sees no dream at all
that is deep sleep
whose place is deep sleep, who has become one, unified
meaning.hi: जिसकी जगह गहरी नींद है, जो एक हो चुका

meaning.en: a single dense mass of awareness
made of bliss/contentment and enjoying that bliss
whose mouth/doorway is thought itself
Prajna, the third quarter

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this one is the lord of everything
this one is the knower of everything
this one is the inner controller
this one is the womb/source of everything
since it is the origin and dissolution of all creatures
meaning.hi: क्योंकि यह सब प्राणियों का उद्गम और लय है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: not awareness facing inward, not facing outward
meaning.hi: न भीतर की ओर ज्ञान, न बाहर की ओर

meaning.en: not both at once
not a dense mass of awareness
not awareness, and not the absence of awareness
unseeable, that which cannot be dealt with
ungraspable, without a distinguishing mark
unthinkable, unable to be pointed to or named
whose essence is the certainty of one single self
meaning.hi: एक आत्मा की प्रतीति का सार

meaning.en: in which the manifest world falls silent
meaning.hi: जिसमें फैला हुआ जगत शांत हो जाता है

meaning.en: peaceful, good/auspicious, without a second
they consider it the fourth
that is the self, that is what is to be known
meaning.hi: वह आत्मा है, वही जानने योग्य है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this same self, understood in terms of the syllable
meaning.hi: यही आत्मा, अक्षर के रूप में

meaning.en: is Om, understood in terms of its sound-units
meaning.hi: ॐ है, मात्राओं के रूप में

meaning.en: the quarters are the sound-units and the sound-units are the quarters
meaning.hi: पाद ही मात्राएँ हैं और मात्राएँ ही पाद

meaning.en: namely, the sounds A, U, and M
meaning.hi: अर्थात् अ, उ, म् की ध्वनियाँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Vaishvanara, whose place is waking
corresponds to A, the first sound-unit
because of the idea of reaching, or of coming first
meaning.hi: प्राप्ति के भाव से, या पहले होने से

meaning.en: he truly reaches/obtains all his desires
meaning.hi: वह सचमुच सारी इच्छाएँ पा लेता है

meaning.en: and he becomes first
whoever knows it this way
meaning.hi: जो इसे इस तरह जानता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Taijasa, whose place is dreaming
corresponds to U, the second sound-unit
because of rising up, or of standing between the two
meaning.hi: उठान से, या दोनों के बीच होने से

meaning.en: he truly raises the flow of his own knowledge
meaning.hi: वह सचमुच अपने ज्ञान की धारा को ऊपर उठाता है

meaning.en: and he becomes equal (treats everyone as an equal)
meaning.hi: और सबको बराबर मानने वाला बन जाता है

meaning.en: no one is born in his family line who fails to know brahman
meaning.hi: उसके कुल में कोई ब्रह्म को न जानने वाला नहीं जन्मता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Prajna, whose place is deep sleep
meaning.hi: प्राज्ञ, जिसकी जगह गहरी नींद है

meaning.en: corresponds to M, the third sound-unit
because of the idea of measuring, or of merging in
meaning.hi: नाप से, या समा जाने से

meaning.en: he truly measures this entire world
meaning.hi: वह सचमुच इस पूरे जगत का नाप ले लेता है

meaning.en: and he becomes the very merging-in
meaning.hi: और स्वयं समा जाना बन जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the fourth, without a sound-unit of its own
with which there is no dealing
in which the manifest world falls silent
meaning.hi: जिसमें फैला हुआ जगत शांत हो जाता है

meaning.en: good/auspicious, without a second
so Om is nothing but the self
meaning.hi: इस तरह ॐ आत्मा ही है

meaning.en: he enters into the self by way of the self
meaning.hi: आत्मा से आत्मा में प्रवेश करता है

meaning.en: whoever knows it this way
meaning.hi: जो इसे इस तरह जानता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
